purpose: Reusable Boolean operations, random and deterministic; process topology and instance token contracts are defined separately.

services.description: Decides at random: returns true or false with equal chance. Use it to model a step that sometimes has to be repeated, such as a check that can fail.
services.returns: true or false. Route on it from the T_out with guards true and false.

services.description: Always returns true, so the place always takes its true route. Use it when runs must repeat exactly, for example to compare timings without random routing.
services.returns: true. Route on it from the T_out with the guard true.
